card.name: Start of hypnagogic and hypoesthesia terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of rare medical words that begin with hyp-, namely "Hyp" + n in hypnagogic and "hypo" before "esthesia". It appears in adverse-event lists of sensory symptoms and in sleep-related warnings.

modes.label: Hypnagogic hallucinations
modes.description: The letter n right after "Hyp" in the heading on sleep paralysis and hypnagogic/hypnopompic hallucinations.

modes.label: Hypoesthesia in symptom lists
modes.description: The piece "hypo" just before "esthesia" in lists of numbness and tingling symptoms.

card.writes: It helps the model complete these rare words, though the promoted tokens look mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the middle of the rare words hypnagogic and hypoesthesia, as they are being spelled out.
